_provenance.class: synthetic-shape (not captured from a live run)
_provenance.purpose: Documents the cumulative-within-one-run interpretation Cretli applies to successive SDKUsageMessage events in a single run.
_provenance.transform: beginHarnessRun() resets the baseline; each sdkEvent usage is diffed against the previous one (recordHarnessUsageSnapshot)
sanitization: agent_id and run_id replaced with fixture placeholders
no conversation content, prompt, reply, transcript, tool payload or credential is present
only type tags, opaque ids and token counts are kept
_provenance.note: The second snapshot is not a per-turn delta: it repeats the first snapshot's cache read. Deltas are what test/audit derive from the pair.
